note: Per-library email-to-print. No central directory exists; each library publishes its own code on its own site. This seed is verified from library websites; extend it by pull request. The agent also resolves unknown libraries live at job time.
pattern: <stem>-bw@ewprints.com (black & white), <stem>-color@ewprints.com (color), <stem>-bw-duplex@ewprints.com (two-sided). Send the PDF, a release code returns by email, release at the library.
